programs.name: surelan
programs.purpose: Compute residual-moveout semblance panels for depth-domain CDP gathers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURELAN - compute residual-moveout semblance for cdp gathers based

params.name: dzratio
params.description: Ratio of output to input depth sampling.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Float accumulation and incremental parameter/depth stepping, linear interpolation, and double-precision sqrt and literals affect rounding. Depth sampling must be nonzero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It interpolates traces and accumulates semblance over multiple traces and trial parameters.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=d1,f1,offset a=2,0,0 b=0,0,20 | surelan nr=5 dr=0.02 fr=-0.04 dzratio=4
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=d1,f1,offset a=2,0,0 b=0,0,10 | surelan nr=4 fr=0 dr=0.03 smute=2 nsmooth=7 verbose=1

programs.name: surelanan
programs.purpose: Compute anisotropic residual-moveout semblance over two parameters at a picked reflector.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURELANAN - REsiduaL-moveout semblance ANalysis for ANisotropic media

params.name: refl
params.description: Reflector-pick file, with depth and CDP per line. Documented as required, but the code does not check getparstring; omitting it uses an uninitialized pointer.

params.name: npicks
params.description: Number of reflector picks. Documented as required, but the code does not check getparint; omitting it leaves the value uninitialized.

params.name: fr1
params.description: First value of the first parameter.

params.name: fr2
params.description: First value of the second parameter.

params.name: dzratio
params.description: Used to set the default smoothing length.

params.name: method
params.description: Reflector interpolation: linear, mono, akima, or spline; selected by first character.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses pow and sqrt with float intermediates, interpolation, and ordered float accumulation. Reflector depth is computed only for the first CDP, and accumulators are not reset between gathers. Missing parameters or an unreadable reflector file can cause undefined behavior; zero half-offset and zero reflector depth make the moveout expression divide by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines reflector interpolation with three-dimensional multi-trace semblance accumulators.

test_cases.command: printf '40 0\n40 10\n' > refl.txt && suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=d1,f1,offset a=2,0,2 b=0,0,4 | surelanan refl=refl.txt npicks=2 nr1=3 nr2=3 fr1=0 fr2=0 nsmooth=5 method=linear

printf '40 0
42 5
44 10
' > refl.txt && suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=d1,f1,offset a=2,0,2 b=0,0,4 | surelanan refl=refl.txt npicks=3 nr1=3 nr2=4 fr1=0 fr2=0 nsmooth=7 method=mono

programs.name: sutivel
programs.purpose: Generate ASCII tables of transversely isotropic velocities and derivatives by angle or slowness.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUTIVEL -  SU Transversely Isotropic velocity table builder

params.name: nangle
params.description: Number of angle samples; code raises values below two after allocating arrays.

params.name: option
params.description: Select NMO velocity, phase velocity, derivatives, diagnostic, or weak-anisotropy output; options 1–14 are described in the selfdoc.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses trigonometric functions, sqrt, mixed float and double arithmetic, and interpolation. Near 90 degrees velocity formulas can be ill-conditioned. Options 7 and 10 populate interpolation inputs but never print the interpolated table; nangle below two can overrun the originally allocated arrays.
programs.difficulty_reason: It evaluates anisotropic velocity formulas and interpolates a computed slowness table.

test_cases.command: sutivel nangle=32 np=32 maxangle=75 option=5 normalize=1 e=0.15 d=0.08
sutivel np=32 option=14 a=2400 b=1200 e=0.2 d=0.1

programs.license_note: Credits John E. Anderson, visiting CSM from Mobil, spring 1994.

programs.name: suvel2df
programs.purpose: Compute a two-velocity semblance panel at one reflection time for each CDP gather.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVEL2DF - compute stacking VELocity semblance for a single time in

params.name: xod
params.description: Offset-to-depth ratio used in the default offsetmax.

params.name: dtratio
params.description: Used in the default smoothing length.

params.name: vavg
params.description: Average velocity used to calculate default offsetmax.

params.name: offsetmax
params.description: Maximum offset used in the calculation; accepted by code but omitted from the selfdoc.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Moveout uses square roots and mixed float/double expressions; interpolation and semblance are accumulated in input order. Out-of-range moveout indices and zero denominators can produce invalid arithmetic or memory access.
programs.difficulty_reason: It performs multi-trace interpolation and semblance accumulation over a two-dimensional velocity grid.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvel2df tn=0.2 offsetm=140 nv=4 nvh=4 nsmooth=5
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=10 | suvel2df tn=0.25 offsetm=70 offsetmax=60 nv=3 nvh=3 fv=1400 fvh=1600 dv=100 dvh=100 verbose=1

programs.name: suvelan
programs.purpose: Compute stacking-velocity semblance panels for CDP gathers, optionally using nonhyperbolic moveout.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVELAN - compute stacking velocity semblance for cdp gathers

params.name: anis1
params.description: Numerator coefficient of the extended quartic moveout term.

params.name: anis2
params.description: Denominator coefficient of the extended quartic moveout term.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ordered float accumulation and interpolation, incremental stepping, sqrt and exponentiation, and mixed float/double expressions affect bitwise results.
programs.difficulty_reason: It interpolates NMO-corrected samples and accumulates semblance across traces and velocities.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvelan nv=5 fv=1400 dv=100 dtratio=4
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvelan nv=4 anis1=1e-12 anis2=1e-6 pwr=2 smute=2 nsmooth=7

programs.license_note: Credits SINTEF, IKU Petroleumsforskning for Bjoern Rommel's power-of-semblance contribution.

programs.name: suvelan_nccs
programs.purpose: Compute normalized cross-correlation-sum velocity panels for CDP gathers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVELAN_NCCS - compute stacking VELocity panel for cdp gathers

params.name: nx
params.default: computed: from first trace header cdpt

params.name: pwr
params.description: Parsed and checked for positivity but not applied to output.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ordered float cross-correlation and energy sums, sqrt, interpolation, and mixed float/double expressions affect rounding. Gather buffering assumes nx traces; on a CDP change the incoming trace is stored before the change is handled, and indexing and stale buffers can cause out-of-bounds or incorrect results.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers gathers and computes normalized cross-correlations for each trial velocity.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvelan_nccs nx=8 nv=4 dv=100
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=10 | suvelan_nccs nx=8 nv=3 fv=1400 dv=75 smute=2 dtratio=4 nsmooth=7

programs.license_note: Based on suvelan.c by Dave Hale; cites Neidell and Taner, Geophysics, 1971.

programs.name: suvelan_nsel
programs.purpose: Compute normalized selective cross-correlation velocity panels for CDP gathers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVELAN_NSEL - compute stacking VELocity panel for cdp gathers

params.name: nx
params.default: computed: from first trace header cdpt

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: from first trace header d2

params.name: smute
params.description: Stretch mute factor; must exceed 1. Selfdoc says 1.5.

params.name: nsmooth
params.description: Smoothing window length; selfdoc says dtratio*2+1.

params.name: pwr
params.description: Parsed and checked for positivity but not applied to output.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ordered float sums, sqrt, floor, interpolation, and mixed float/double expressions affect results. Selection indices depend on rounded square roots; invalid dx, tau, or gather sizes can cause invalid arithmetic or indexing. Gather-boundary buffering can write beyond nx and retain stale data.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers gathers and computes normalized correlations using offset-dependent pair selection.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvelan_nsel nx=8 dx=20 nv=4 tau=0.3
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvelan_nsel nx=8 dx=20 nv=3 tau=0.5 smute=2 dtratio=4 nsmooth=7

programs.license_note: Based on suvelan.c by Dave Hale; cites Neidell and Taner, Geophysics, 1971, and Celis's 2002 CSM thesis.

programs.name: suvelan_uccs
programs.purpose: Compute unnormalized cross-correlation-sum velocity panels for CDP gathers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVELAN_UCCS - compute stacking VELocity panel for cdp gathers

params.name: nx
params.default: computed: from first trace header cdpt

params.name: pwr
params.description: Parsed and checked for positivity but not applied to output.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ordered float correlation sums, sqrt, interpolation, and mixed float/double expressions affect rounding. Gather-boundary buffering can write beyond nx and retain stale data; the implemented sum includes the current sample's square in its cumulative product.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers gathers and accumulates cross-correlation sums over trial velocities and time windows.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvelan_uccs nx=8 nv=4 dv=100
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=10 | suvelan_uccs nx=8 nv=3 fv=1400 dv=75 smute=2 dtratio=4 nsmooth=7

programs.license_note: Based on suvelan.c by Dave Hale; cites Neidell and Taner, Geophysics, 1971.

programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVELAN_USEL - compute stacking velocity panel for cdp gathers

params.name: nx

params.name: dx

params.description: Stretch mute factor; must exceed 1. Selfdoc says 1.5.

suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=20 | suvelan_usel nx=8 dx=20 nv=3 tau=0.5 smute=2 dtratio=4 nsmooth=7
